_comment: From 2 to 5 GeV, one matched scalar event measure replaces the complete pooled hadronic branching fraction while leaving leptonic rows unchanged. The selected EventCalc rate prescription is carried into the event generator exactly: Blackstone central is the main prediction, Blackstone lower and upper are its alternatives, and 1809.01876 is the corrected Boiarska-Winkler prescription check. Each prescription supplies its own absolute exclusive and inclusive rates; the common scalar source projector controls unresolved fragmentation and joins the default source-conditioned fragmentation continuously from 4 to 5 GeV. Choosing default fragmentation in the host disables this replacement.
